description: DG-6 over-decisiveness — GROUNDED partial resolution: per-battle combat-effectiveness (CEV) friction. Jordan directive 2026-07-22 ('validate emergent results top-down from historical precedent; extend code as required to resolve standing issues using academic research, military theory, mathematics, historical precedent'). Root cause CONFIRMED (mathematical): melee attrition sums N independent per-soldier dice -> CV self-averages ~1/sqrt(N) (measured 0.89->0.06 for N=4->1024); pool scales linearly with troops -> compute_degree near-deterministic from the force ratio -> outcomes collapse to 100%/0% where history shows bands. Fix (two research passes, ~200k tokens; grounding in audit/2026-07-22-mass-battle-stress-test/dg6_friction_resolution.md): keep the self-averaging attrition core, add a per-BATTLE, per-side multiplicative CEV factor M ~ LogNormal(0, sigma^2) drawn ONCE per battle (orchestration._draw_friction_cev, lazy so multi-turn re-entries keep the single draw), multiplying the subunit combat pool (core/exchange). Law of total variance: the attrition term ->0 with N (kept), the once-per-battle shock stays O(1) -> scale-invariant outcome variance (Dupuy CEV / Clausewitz friction / stochastic-Lanchester; Kingman 2002, Beyerchen 1992, Rowland, Sabin Lost Battles). CALIBRATED gauge-INDEPENDENTLY to the Dupuy DLEDB force-ratio win-curve (NOT the gauge, I5): sigma=1.1 reproduces 1.2:1->57% (t55), 1.5:1->62% (t62), 2:1->70% (t70), 3:1->82% (t80). Mechanism verified (test_friction_cev.py, 7): default-inert/byte-exact off; drawn once per battle not per turn; large-force 2:1 collapses to >=95% without friction and stays banded <90% with it (the scale-invariant-variance fix); I1/I2 hold. HONEST FINDING -- friction is NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT, ships DEFAULT OFF: the 20-row history gauge moves 6/20 -> 4/20 with uniform friction ON, because (1) envelopment rows (H3/H4) stay ~100% -- their over-decisiveness is STRUCTURAL (envelopment geometry), needing a CONJUNCTIVE gate (Goldsworthy/Sabin: center-holds x cavalry-sufficiency x terrain), not symmetric noise; (2) friction BREAKS the Stage E brace repel (C2/C6 REPELLED->NOT-REPELLED: a big CEV draw lets cavalry break a braced line, but Waterloo-squares repel is near-deterministic) -- friction must be exempted/damped in the brace repel; (3) near-parity rows pushed just out of band. So it ships gated OFF (byte-exact, inert; grid oracle unaffected -- I4). Complete DG-6 resolution = (a) this CEV friction + (b) conjunctive envelopment gate + (c) brace-repel preservation -- scoped as follow-on. needs_jordan: default-flip + the (b)/(c) design calls. No constant tuned to the gauge.

description: Octagon facing = DAMAGE-RECEIVED MULTIPLIER (Jordan directive 2026-07-22/23, verbatim: 'the facing octagon is a damage-received multiplier -- attacks from behind do like TWICE as much damage as from the front; cells are NOT able to turn around instantaneously upon contact -- there must be time spent to react, at least a couple ticks; PLUS if attacked from MULTIPLE SIDES the rotate-in/out support logic is divided AND compromised by shock+distraction, so it's extra bad, not just a divide-by-two'). Replaces the legacy -2-dice octagon POOL/sigma penalty (too weak: measured legacy rear only 1.25x front casualties, and a -1 flank vanished entirely after round()). THREE REQUIREMENTS, each implemented + regression-asserted: (1) ARC = DAMAGE MULTIPLIER -- new `_octagon_dmg_mod` computes the pure per-cell facing arc (front GREEN 1.0x / flank YELLOW 1.5x / rear RED 2.0x; mult = 1 - arc*(RED-1)/2, capped at RED) multiplying the DEFENDER's casualties (dmg_a *= _a_dmg_mult); the pool/sigma angle-penalty is zeroed under the flag (no double-count). SEPARATE from the legacy `_per_cell_angle_mod` (which also bundles the wrapper/pocket/roll-up POOL penalties). Reads the arc against the LOCAL attacker centroid (attacker cells within OCTAGON_LOCAL_REACH=2.0 of each defender cell; global fallback) so a WIDE line's wing cell in a head-on clash stays GREEN instead of mis-reading the enemy CENTRE as an oblique flank -- VERIFIED front->1.00x, rear->2.00x EXACTLY per-seed (the global-centroid version spuriously inflated frontal fights to 1.25x). Compounds with the loss of frontal brace/charge-shock resistance -> a braced front that parries a frontal blow to ZERO is annihilated when the same blow lands behind it (Cannae annihilation-by-encirclement; du Picq flank/rear lethality). (2) REACTION NOT INSTANTANEOUS -- a cell hit outside its front arc keeps its EXPOSED facing until FACING_REACTION_TICKS=2 elapse, and only refuses if it can SEE the threat (angle <= FOV_HALF_DEG=105deg) AND is not frontally PINNED (an attacker in its front arc within PC_PIN_REACH). A REAR strike is in the blind arc (>105deg) -> never perceived -> the cell never wheels -> the 2.0x persists the WHOLE engagement (du Picq: reaction time under surprise). Per-cell reaction clock (subunit._react_since) persists across ticks, resets when facing the threat. (3) MULTI-SIDE SHOCK -- eng_counts>=2 -> extra *(1+MULTI_SIDE_SHOCK=0.5) COMPOUNDING on top of the arc multiplier (orderly rank-relief collapses under encirclement shock+distraction; worse than a halving). SUPERSESSION (deliberate): under PC_OCTAGON_DMG=1 (DEFAULT ON) the legacy wrapper-depth-resist / pocket / oblique-roll-up POOL-penalty envelopment machinery goes DORMANT (its output zeroed out of the pool) -- subsumed by the new model (wrap -> defender-cell rear arc -> 2x; both-lateral-sides -> multi-side shock; roll-up dropped, depth still tells via Lanchester strength). LEGACY PATH PRESERVED BYTE-EXACT under PC_OCTAGON_DMG=0 (verified: `_a_dmg_mult=1` int not 1.0 avoids float-coercing integer casualties, which had moved the digest -- caught + fixed). I4: the multiplier runs on BOTH grid and field paths (else field != grid). Head-on single-subunit battery rows are all-GREEN -> mult 1.0 -> byte-identical; the 3 flanking rows (envelop/cannae/oblique) legitimately move. title: The cell is the primitive for MORALE — aggregate-up/modulate-down, per-cell du Picq break-point, contagion; default flipped ON on measurement
summary: Executes Jordan's 2026-07-25 directive ("the cell needs to be the primitive for morale, discipline, quality, stamina, route, health, armour, facing, damage, troops count, etc") for MORALE, the first state to move. Before this the cell was the primitive for GEOMETRY only, so Jordan's own test case ("a cell should be able to have worse morale than another cell in same subunit") was not representable: a rear cell being cut down and a front cell holding shared one scalar. PHASE 1 - cells carry morale; the subunit's morale is the troop-weighted MEAN of its live cells (derived, not stored) and that holistic value pulls its own cells back toward it at a discipline-gated rate (cohere_cells, signed both ways, conserves the aggregate). Erosion scales by FRACTION of the cell, not absolute count, so dense cells are not spuriously braver. PHASE 2 - a broken cell (morale <= 0) stops contributing combat weight while its men REMAIN present and killable (a break is not a casualty event); breaks spread over the 8-neighbourhood lattice, so the spread follows the formation's own shape with no shape-specific code; a body whose broken cells hold CELL_BREAK_ROUT_FRAC of its men is no longer a formation. PHASE 2B - the phase that made phase 2 reachable at all. Phases 1+2 measured BYTE-IDENTICAL to phase 1 across all 20 rows; instrumentation showed 72 of 144 cells 'broken' at exactly -1.0, one uniform write, i.e. cells were breaking as a CONSEQUENCE of the body routing. Root cause was an ASYMMETRY, not a magnitude: bodies get erosion AND a du Picq break-point, cells had erosion only, so a cell had to be destroyed twice over to break by erosion and the body always won that race by construction. check_cell_breaks() gives each cell its own break-point drawn in the same historical 15-30% band, discipline-skewed. The casualty column is the evidence and it is a mechanism producing a SHAPE, not a fitted number: loser losses fall out of 31-40% into 26-30% (H6 79.2 -> 48.9, C7 39.9 -> 32.1), which is du Picq's claim that a body comes apart before it is destroyed. The cells break first and CELL_BREAK_ROUT_FRAC ends the body before the subunit-level draw is consulted. title: RETRACTION of the same-day PC_CELL_MORALE flip — the measurement's two arms were not comparable
summary: Supersedes the prior ED-MB-0042 entry's FLIP paragraph. The per-cell morale MECHANISM (phases 1/2/2b) stands and is unchanged; the DEFAULT FLIP and its measurement are withdrawn. CAUSE: between_turn_recovery and reset_morale_between_battles both write the morale SCALAR, which eff_morale stops reading the moment cells are seeded, so under PC_CELL_MORALE they are silent no-ops (verified directly: knock a body's cells to 2.0, call both, still 2.0). The gauge's multi mode runs multi-turn battles and resets morale between them, so the ON arm fought with morale that never recovered while the OFF arm's did. 'The loser breaks earlier' is precisely what an unrecoverable body also produces, so the reported 7->8/20 win-share and 2->7/20 casualty-realism gains cannot be attributed to the mechanism. Reverted: default OFF, _PINNED_OFF back to '0', both byte-exact goldens back to their pre-flip digests, default-pinning test restored with the reason. SAME DEFECT CLASS AS THE erode_morale SILENT NO-OP caught earlier in this same lane and session. That one was fixed as a single instance with no sweep for the pattern, so it recurred and this time reached a shipped default and a golden re-record. The transferable lesson is about the UNIT OF REPAIR: when a defect's cause is 'a representation change orphaned its writers', the repair is every writer, found by grep, not the writer that happened to fail. TWO GENUINE DEFECTS FOUND BY THE FAILING SUITE AND KEPT, both real bugs in the phase-1/2b work and independent of the flip: (1) BORN-BROKEN SUBUNITS — seed_cell_morale ran in Subunit.__post_init__, but a subunit with morale=None inherits from its parent Unit and the _unit back-ref is not set until Unit.__post_init__, strictly later; so an inheriting subunit seeded every cell at eff_morale's no-parent fallback of 0, i.e. born broken, emitting no combat weight and unable to recover because once cells exist eff_morale reads THEM and never falls back to the correct parent scalar. Inheriting subunits are now seeded from Unit.__post_init__. The gauge path passes morale explicitly, which is why the targeted tests and the measurement were green while ten unrelated suite tests were not. (2) A 1-ULP AGGREGATE DEFEATING AN IDENTITY — the troop-weighted mean of N equal values is that value mathematically but not in floats (15 cells at 6.0 -> 5.999999999999999); _morale_sigma divides by morale_start, so a body at full morale reported sigma -1.8e-16 instead of 0, enough to cross a DAMAGE_BY_DEGREE boundary and turn a 6.0 exchange into 0.0. A uniform body now returns its cells' value exactly. My own t=0 identity test HID this by asserting with pytest.approx — the one assertion form that cannot see an ulp; it now asserts ==. BLOCKER for re-flipping is the scalar-write sweep, not another gauge run. Known sites: between_turn_recovery (unit + atom), reset_morale_between_battles (unit + atom), the rout write u.morale = 0.0, Unit.erode_morale, and core/state.py's atom.morale = atom.eff_morale.

FLIP CENSUS (guarded vs unguarded verdict compared per call, whole battery): unit 17,312 calls / 0 flips (0.000%); cell 31,958 / 38 (0.119%); unit_field 18,152 / 0 (0.000%); cell_field 20,412 / 14 (0.069%). ALL 52 flips are Partial -> Success -- one direction, the guard never demotes -- and every one is `net` 1-4 ulp below a CONTINUOUS `ob` that it equals mathematically (measured distance 2.22e-16 .. 8.88e-16, five to six orders TIGHTER than the epsilon, so the epsilon's WIDTH is not load-bearing: any value in [8.9e-16, 1e-9] yields this identical result). WHY IT FAILED -- a G1 failure inside the correction to G1. The audit's '0 flips in 209,778 calls', and the orchestrator's own N=3,120 replication of it recorded in plan SS0's provenance table, were BOTH taken at PER_CELL=0 -- the one configuration where the incidence really is zero. Generalising that to the engine is exactly the existence-is-not-rate error G1 exists to prevent. S1.2 IS NOT INCIDENCE-ZERO: in the shipped per-cell modes a 1-ulp float error erases an entire exchange (Partial -> 0 damage at the universal dr=1, where Success -> 3) in ~0.1% of degree calls. A2 is therefore a LIVE CORRECTNESS FIX, not hygiene, and the two PER_CELL=1 goldens were re-recorded DELIBERATELY with the delta published (rule 4): cell dc3d3414... -> f58a9cb4..., cell_field 3a0952b3... -> 13bd02dd.... RECONCILIATION (plan A2's explicit requirement -- two overlapping exactness regimes is how the next confound gets built). units.py:621-631's exact uniform-aggregate fix is an EXACTNESS regime and STAYS AUTHORITATIVE where the correct answer is derivable; a downstream tolerance cannot recover information a producer threw away, and that fix also serves callers that never reach compute_degree. Exactness where exactness is derivable; tolerance only where it is not. Stated in-file at both sites. title: C1: per-phase casualty attribution on the trace seam; conservation exact; the first merge-guard mutation was vacuous and running it is what showed that
description: Plan-v2 SS5 C1. Every hp loss is tagged with SOURCE and TICK through the existing start_trace/trace_event seam. FOUR SITES, the complete set (grepped `.hp =` across orchestration + hierarchy/units + percell): the per-turn melee and volley application in run_battle, pursuit_damage, and freed_attacker_damage. The fifth `.hp =` is `hp = hp_max` at construction, not damage. This is load-bearing rather than decorative: it is the only way to measure the inverted causal shape (the engine kills the loser and THEN breaks him, where history breaks then kills) and the only way to check a 'this is a no-op' claim per SOURCE rather than in aggregate -- A2's sigma snap and B1c's re-key both make that claim. Before it, every such question needed a bespoke probe and there are now 23 of them; that cost IS the finding. CONSERVATION IS THE GATE AND IT HOLDS EXACTLY: 20 seeds x 2 sides, sum(attributed) == (before - after) with ZERO drift, asserted as equality rather than pytest.approx (an exactness claim tested with a tolerance is not a weak test, it is an absent one -- SS0.1 #2). Two subtleties are encoded rather than assumed: (a) loss is attributed from the CLAMPED movement, not nominal damage -- the two differ on the killing blow, so a nominal-damage conservation claim fails on every battle ending in annihilation, which at this engine's casualty levels is most of them; (b) the melee/volley split is proportional to nominal share of that clamped total, so the parts sum to the whole even when the clamp bites. INSTRUMENTING NEVER RESTRUCTURES THE INSTRUMENTED: attribution brackets each EXISTING assignment (before/after), leaving arithmetic and ordering byte-identical. A single apply-and-tag owner would be tidier and would also change float ordering -- exactly the class of 'harmless' change this lane keeps being burned by. Zero RNG draws, no float writes to engine state; the whole seam is a no-op when tracing is off. THE FIRST MERGE-GUARD MUTATION WAS VACUOUS, AND RUNNING IT IS WHAT SHOWED THAT. The plan's merge guard is 'all four digests byte-identical with tracing off, mutation-verified by inserting a state-perturbing event and watching a digest move'. Planting random.random() INSIDE attribute_hp_loss moved NO digest -- because with tracing off the function is never called at all on the bat.py path: the main site is gated by tracing_on(), and pursuit/freed_attacker fire only in run_multi_unit_battle, which the battery does not exercise. Reporting that as 'mutation-verified' would have been false. Re-planted at the seam's own call site, unconditional and on the hot path: the digest MOVED, 241f04e5... -> bb5acf02.... BOTH RESULTS TOGETHER ARE THE GUARD -- the first shows the instrumentation is structurally unreachable when off, the second shows the digest is genuinely sensitive at that point, so byte-exactness there is evidence rather than vacuity. All four goldens verified byte-exact with tracing off. GUARDS: tests/valoria/test_casualty_attribution.py (5) -- conservation across 20 seeds with an `assert checked >= 20` non-vacuity counter; source/tick well-formedness; a ranged matchup asserting `volley` rows actually appear (non-vacuity for the SPLIT, not just the total: a conservation test alone passes happily if every loss is filed under one label); inertness with tracing off; and an IN-SUITE mutation that untags the melee path and asserts conservation then FAILS -- the plan's 'mutation-verified by untagging one path', done rather than described. No constant tuned, no default flipped, no golden re-recorded.

title: B1c cheap path: rekey_cells — six per-cell maps were left holding dead ids on every drift, not the three the audit named
description: Plan-v2 B1c's 'immediate, independent of B1a' item. check_drift re-keyed cell_troops and (on the node path) _node_pos, and NOTHING else. MEASURED over the bat.py `cell` battery: 10 drift events, and SIX maps non-empty at drift and left holding dead ids in ALL TEN -- cell_offsets, cell_offsets_c, halted_cells, cell_last_speed, cell_facing_vec, _cell_target. That is THREE MORE than the audit named (it listed cell_facing_vec, halted_cells, _speed_accum; _speed_accum measured empty at drift in this battery), and the pair it missed is the worse one: cell_offsets/cell_offsets_c are ACCUMULATED DISPLACEMENT from the spawn lattice, so a missing entry does not degrade gracefully -- `.get(pid, 0)` snaps the drifted body back to its SPAWN row mid-advance, which is strictly worse than the facing loss that was named. FIX: Subunit.rekey_cells(new_ids), the GRID-path analogue of _rekey_node_state, built to mirror that method's already-ratified policy rather than invent one: the sub-unit re-organizes in place, it does not teleport back to spawn, and a formation reorganizing does not reset which way it is looking. Per-map policy, each derivable rather than a judgement call: displacement -> every new id inherits the body's MEAN accumulated offset (centroid preserved); cell_facing_vec -> every new id inherits the body's mean committed facing, normalized, explicitly NOT the advance_dir default; _cell_target -> redistributed like cell_troops, since it IS a prescribed density and the prescription follows the shape; transient per-tick state (halted_cells, merged_cells, cell_last_speed, _speed_accum) -> CLEARED, because a body that has just re-formed is not still holding a halt, a merge or a velocity accumulator from a formation it no longer has, and clearing is the only choice that cannot carry a dead id forward. DELIBERATELY NOT TOUCHED: cell_morale, cell_start_troops, cell_breakpoint. Drift has no old->new key bijection, and per B1c at least two are SS6-class RULINGS not derivations -- cell_morale (mean? troop-weighted? carrying the low-morale corner is the feature's whole point) and cell_breakpoint (a DRAWN value: redraw and shift the _cell_random stream, or inherit from which dead cell?). Empty at the shipped PC_CELL_MORALE=0, so leaving them is inert today. GOLDEN DELTA, decomposed BEFORE recording: only cell_field moved (13bd02dd... -> 2a9214eb...). unit / cell / unit_field / cell_cm all byte-exact. Arm decomposition on cell_field: facing correction ALONE reproduces the new digest; everything EXCEPT facing reproduces the OLD one -- so facing preservation is the sole mover and the displacement/target/transient corrections are real but outcome-inert on this battery.
